# Diagnostics

FluutCAM reports a problem as a diagnostic: a message with a code. An **error** stops a toolpath from calculating until you fix it. A **warning** lets the calculation run and tells you about something to check. The app shows diagnostics in the Messages tab, next to the setting they are about in the inspector, and in the status bar. The command line prints them as `error [t1] code: message` or `warning [t1] code: message`, where `t1` is the toolpath id.

The message in your window may fill in numbers and names where this page shows `…`. A code with `<type>` appears once for each toolpath type, with the type id in its place. See [Troubleshooting](Troubleshooting) for the problems you are most likely to meet first.

## Settings (`param`)

| Code | Kind | Message | What it means and what to do |
|---|---|---|---|
| `param.<type>.<setting>.range` | error | `…` must be … | A setting of the toolpath is wrong or risky. Select the toolpath and look in the inspector: the message sits next to the setting it is about. |

## Simulation (`sim`)

| Code | Kind | Message | What it means and what to do |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sim.cancelled` | error | the simulation was cancelled | The simulation could not run or found a problem in the program. The message says what. |
| `sim.findings.dropped` | warning | … more findings not listed | The simulation could not run or found a problem in the program. The message says what. |
| `sim.fixture` | error | the tool meets the … at (…, …, …), segment … | The tool meets a chuck, tailstock or clamp that turns with the part. Move the toolpath, shorten the tool or its holder, or correct the fixture's size or position in the Setup. |
| `sim.index_turn` | error | the stock turns … mm into the tool, at (…, …, …) from `…`, before Setup `…` | When the stock turns for this Setup, material reaches the tool where the previous toolpath left it. Check the stock and the order of the Setups. |
| `sim.result.missing` | error | calculate first: … | Calculate the toolpaths first, then simulate. |
| `sim.setup.missing` | error | Setup `…` is not in the project | The simulation could not run or found a problem in the program. The message says what. |
| `sim.setup.rotary` | error | Setup `…` is rotary; rotary Setups are not simulated yet | Rotary Setups cannot be simulated yet (see Known limits). Calculate and post them without it. |
| `sim.stock.full` | warning | Setup `…` starts from its full stock, not from `…`'s: … | The simulation could not run or found a problem in the program. The message says what. |
| `sim.tool.unsupported` | error | toolpath `…`: the tool has no usable size | The simulation could not run or found a problem in the program. The message says what. |

## Posting (`post`)

| Code | Kind | Message | What it means and what to do |
|---|---|---|---|
| `post.compile` | error | …: … | The post processor could not be loaded or could not write the program. The message says why. |
| `post.emit` | error |  | The post processor could not be loaded or could not write the program. The message says why. |
| `post.load` | error | …: … | The post id is wrong or its file is missing. Choose one from the list (see Machines and posts). |
| `post.setup.missing` | error | Setup `…` is not in the project | The post processor could not be loaded or could not write the program. The message says why. |
